issues.message: "lost" is never seen: it is off the 300x200 canvas, fully transparent, at size 0, or never drawn
"jumper" jumps when the loop starts again: x ends at 260 and starts at 40. Add a step that takes it back, or set loop to false
"strobe" flashes three times within a second, which can harm people with photosensitive epilepsy; slow it down or fade it less
